pacing.context: Six cycles: inhale four one-second counts, exhale six. Total planned duration 60 seconds.
pacing.answer: The exercise has six cycles. Each cycle uses four one-second counts for inhale and six for exhale, for 60 seconds of planned pacing.
pacing.brief: Inhale for four one-second counts, then exhale for six. Repeat six times: 60 seconds. You can stop whenever you choose.

motion.context: Animated circle is optional. Text only shows words and counts. Cue changes preserve pace.
motion.answer: Inhale uses a muted green circle; exhale uses muted blue. The phase word and count carry the same information, so color is never required. Choose Text only before or during the exercise to remove the moving shape. Changing the cue preserves your place and does not save a preference.
motion.brief: Text only removes the moving circle while keeping the phase and count. You can change cues without losing your place.

storage.context: Local SQLite stores questions, replies, session history and explicit cue/profile choices. Check save status. History and profile are reviewable, resettable and deletable.
storage.answer: The app attempts to save questions, displayed replies, session records and explicit cue/profile choices in local SQLite. Check each save status: a failed write is not a saved record. Retry or use Leave without saving after ending; unsaved changes may be lost. Review or delete saved records in History. Live mode sends the current question and approved facts to local Ollama; profile and usage-history tailoring uses reviewed local rules, not raw conversations sent to the model.
storage.brief: Check the save status before leaving. Saved questions, replies, sessions and explicit preferences stay in local SQLite and can be reviewed or deleted in History.

controls.context: Pause holds your place. Resume continues. End stops halfway immediately. Opening support pauses.
controls.answer: Pause holds your place. Resume continues the same phase or step. End stops the exercise. Crisis support stays available, and opening it pauses an active exercise.
controls.brief: Pause holds your place; Resume continues it. End stops immediately. Crisis support remains available and pauses practice when opened.

scope.context: mello is a localhost coursework skills prototype with breathing, grounding and STOP. Educational assistant explains approved application information; no therapy, diagnosis or monitoring.
scope.answer: I’m mello’s app assistant, not a therapist. I can explain the practice and reviewed information, but I can’t diagnose, provide treatment, or monitor anyone.
scope.brief: I’m an app assistant, not a therapist. I can explain the practice, but can’t diagnose, provide treatment, or monitor anyone.

start.context: Start begins the exercise from Ready. Answering a question first is optional.
start.answer: Choose a practice on the Practice page and select its Start button. Each guide has a planned 60-second sequence. Starting is your choice; you do not need to answer questions first.
start.brief: Choose a practice and Start when you want. No question or check-in is required.

unsupported.context: Personal mental-health advice or unrelated requests are outside the app-help scope.
unsupported.answer: I am a coursework app assistant, not a therapist, and nobody monitors this prototype. I can explain the exercise, controls, saved records and reviewed general information. Personal assessments, diagnoses and treatment advice are outside this prototype. The Crisis support control is always available.
unsupported.brief: I am a coursework app assistant, not a therapist, and nobody monitors this prototype. I can explain reviewed app information, but cannot diagnose or provide treatment. Crisis support is always available.

preferences.context: Remember explicitly saves the cue. Local profile explicitly saves standard/brief reply detail and optional saved-practice context, off by default. Reset and override remain available. No inferred mood.
preferences.answer: Choose a cue, then select Remember this choice to restore it next time. Reset preference removes it. Your local profile can save reply length and, only if you choose, use your cue and saved practice history in assistant replies. Save profile makes those choices persistent; Reset profile returns to standard replies with history context off. History reuse only copies a cue for review; it does not remember it or start an exercise.
preferences.brief: Remember saves your cue. Reset removes it. Your local profile also saves reply length and an optional choice to use saved practice context; you can change or reset them.

checkin.context: No required questionnaire or emotional-state inference. Explicit cue and reply-detail preferences personalize the UI; saved practice context in replies is optional and reversible.
checkin.answer: No questionnaire or mood check-in is required. You can start directly, choose your cue, or ask an optional question. The app does not infer stress or a diagnosis from clicks, wording or history. Personalization uses your explicit cue and reply-detail choices. You can opt in to factual saved-practice context in replies and switch it off again.
checkin.brief: No check-in is required. The app uses explicit choices, not inferred stress, diagnoses or emotions. Optional saved practice context can be switched off.

stress.context: NIMH describes stress as a physical or mental response to an external demand, such as schoolwork. General educational definition only; no personal assessment or advice.
stress.answer: Stress can be a mental or physical response to an outside demand, such as schoolwork. This is general information from NIMH, not an assessment of your experience. This prototype does not determine a cause, diagnose a condition or choose treatment.
stress.brief: Stress can be a mental or physical response to an outside demand, such as schoolwork. This NIMH definition is general information, not an assessment of you.

resources.context: Reviewed links: NIMH stress fact sheet; AIS military/veteran resource page; Grey House handbook publisher listing only; APA DSM overview. No handbook full text, clinical audit or diagnostic use.
resources.answer: The reading links distinguish general information from professional references and book listings. NIMH provides a public stress fact sheet; AIS lists military/veteran resources; Grey House describes a handbook whose full text has not been supplied; APA explains the DSM. These links do not turn this prototype into therapy or a diagnostic tool.
resources.brief: The reading shelf labels public information, professional overviews and publisher listings. No full handbook was imported, and these links do not make the app a diagnostic tool.

about.context: Purpose/features: three fixed 60-second coursework practices (4/6 breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding and STOP), optional app questions, explicit breathing cue/profile preferences and dated history. No therapy/diagnosis/monitoring.
about.answer: mello gives you a simple place to try three short practices: paced breathing, 5–4–3–2–1 grounding and STOP. You choose a practice, follow the reviewed steps, and pause or stop whenever you want. I can help you find features, explain the practices, and explore the reading shelf.
about.brief: mello brings three short guided practices, optional app help, and your saved settings and history together. You choose when to start, pause, or stop.

skills.context: Three fixed 60-second practices: 4/6 breathing; 5-4-3-2-1 sensory grounding (see five, feel four, hear three, smell two, taste one); STOP (stop, take a step back, observe, proceed mindfully). Direct Start, no typing. Pause for more time; End anytime. App owns steps and timing.
skills.answer: Choose from three practices on the Practice page: paced breathing, 5–4–3–2–1 grounding, or STOP. Each has a 60-second guided sequence, with Pause for more time and End whenever you choose. Grounding moves through seeing, feeling, hearing, smelling and tasting; the interface offers recalled examples when a sense is unavailable. STOP follows Stop, Take a step back, Observe, and Proceed mindfully. No response or written answer is required.
skills.brief: Practice offers breathing, 5–4–3–2–1 grounding and STOP. Each has a fixed one-minute guide. Pause for more time, or End whenever you choose.

current.text: Your current breathing cue is Text only.
current.animated: Your current breathing cue is Animated circle.

remembered.text: Your remembered cue is Text only; you can override it without changing the saved choice.
remembered.animated: Your remembered cue is Animated circle; you can override it without changing the saved choice.

last_status.stopped: Your latest saved breathing practice was stopped. A fresh start is optional; finishing is not required.
last_status.interrupted: Your latest saved breathing practice was interrupted. A new exercise starts from Ready rather than resuming that record.
last_status.completed: Your latest saved breathing practice completed its planned sequence. Starting again is optional.

last_cue.text: That practice last recorded Text only.
last_cue.animated: That practice last recorded Animated circle.

personalization.none: There is no saved finished, stopped or interrupted breathing practice to refer to yet.
